task: Sessions currently expire only by idle timeout, and Touch pushes that deadline forward on each authenticated request. Add an absolute lifetime argument to NewStore and store it on the session in Issue; Slide must extend only the idle deadline. Get and Slide must return ErrExpired when either deadline is past, and the middleware must keep answering those failures with an unauthorized response. Rename Session.ExpiresAt to IdleDeadline in the store, the session snapshot, and the handlers, and set the session cookie's Expires to the absolute expiry both at login and whenever the idle deadline slides. When the caller supplies a RequestedBy value, login and logout must record it on the audit entry, and when it is absent they must keep recording the user id.
